scope: Independent finite causal adjudication of two previously retained public development nominations. Source labels and previous empty outputs are not truth. No new sampling or holdout claim.

cases.hypothesis: g6 attacks Qh5. Confinement may require connected checking-fork responses rather than only direct queen capture: Qh4 appears to allow Nxf3+, attacking Kg1 and Qh4. The source Bxg5 hxg5 Qxh8 Qxh8 gives up both Ng5 and Rh8 before collecting the queen and bishop, so any material bound must subtract both losses.
plannedChecks: Enumerate every legal White defence, checking moves and queen flights.
Verify source debt and the Qh4 checking-fork branch using independent legal rules.
Use one fixed bounded shared-kernel query and preserve unknown/exhausted branches.
Test a removed fork partner and safe queen escape control without treating altered boards as legal game continuations.

cases.hypothesis: Rd2 does not check because Pe2 blocks the rook ray to Kf2. The source continuation trades the queen for Rc1, then returns Rd2 to d1 with a promotion-related threat. That displayed cooperation is not proof that every legal root reply loses material or permits promotion.
plannedChecks: Enumerate all actual root replies, captures and counterchecks.
Account queen-for-rook debt at each displayed ply and locate the connected promotion/skewer mechanism.
Check direct queen trade before Rd2 and a removed e2-pawn control for causal dependence.
Report unsupported branches or horizons explicitly instead of admitting a clearance label from geometry.

budget: Existing bounded kernel queries, at most16384 nodes each, no production budget increase. Independent move enumeration is finite; no full tablebase, corpus, network or owner data. Root/full and colour reflections retain the same hypotheses.
